messages.subject: Melbourne Sealtech - response to letter of claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

Please find attached our client's substantive response to your letter of claim. In short, liability is denied: our client says the seals conformed to specification and passed QC, and that the failures are attributable to misapplication and mis-installation. Our client also relies on the exclusion and cap in clauses 11 and 12. Our client is nonetheless willing to explore a without-prejudice discussion.

Yours faithfully,
Adam Selby
Denham Lewis LLP

messages.subject: FW: Melbourne Sealtech - response to letter of claim
messages.plaintextBody:
As expected - blanket denial and they're leaning on the cap and the 'contaminated water / bad installation' story. Trentham's findings on the failure surfaces should knock out the contamination point. Let's proceed to issue once we have the report position clear.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
